notes: Class profile figures are the Class of 2027 section of Wharton's own class profile page (profile as of August 12, 2025), which draws its figures with JavaScript: a plain fetch shows them as zero placeholders, so they were read in a browser on September 27, 2026 (INC-0146). Until then the record held the Class of 2026 section and Poets&Quants' Class of 2027 GMAT Focus. Wharton does not publish an acceptance rate; a prior third-party figure was dropped. The career report PDF is hosted on Wharton's Pardot storage and linked from mba.wharton.upenn.edu/mba-career-services/.
